name: 22203 · Arlington, VA
findings: ZIP 22203 (Arlington) has 206 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22203 (Arlington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22203 (Arlington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 97 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
